summary: Midnight pass, 3 Oct. One new tractor worth knowing about: a Kubota M9540, 95hp, cab, loader with 4-in-1 bucket, 2,230 hours, pre-emission, $65,000 at Moss Vale. It meets every spec but is about 520km out, so it is a decent, not a call-today find. The drop deck trailer search turned up a 2020 Panus tri-axle drop deck at Pickles Dubbo, timed sale closing 6 Oct, and a 2005 plant trailer with ramps at Slattery Canberra, opening bid $1,800, closing 8 Oct. Everything else is unchanged across 44 finds.
headlines: Tractor: Kubota M9540, 95hp, cab, loader and 4-in-1 bucket, 2,230 hours, no AdBlue, $65,000, Moss Vale. Meets every spec but is 520km out.
Drop deck: Pickles 2020 Panus tri-axle drop deck, 22 t ATM, Dubbo, timed sale closes 6 Oct, no price shown yet, likely over $20,000.
Drop deck: Slattery 2005 dual axle plant trailer with ramps, 5.3m deck, Canberra, opening bid $1,800, closes 8 Oct; flat deck, rating not stated.
Portable home: Bendigo expandable, kitchen and bathroom, $28,000, photo added. Deniliquin cabin, $7,000, still live, 150km.
Offsets, ripper, chainsaw, winch and Mac mini: no price moves. Lloyds Austral expandables $7,900 and $6,300 close Wed 7 Oct, 590km.
